snippet.title: Night Plane - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
*Play the Night Plane Demo NOW on Steam:* https://store.steampowered.com/app/3310570/Night_Plane/

Welcome aboard Night Plane, a job-sim horror game where you work as a flight attendant aboard a plane that may be carrying more than ordinary passengers.

✈️ Check tickets of passengers before boarding.
🥤 Serve food and drinks during the flight.
🧳 Assist passengers with their luggage, respond to their requests, and make sure everyone receives the service they expect.
👀 Stay alert and identify the doppelgänger demons hiding among your passengers.

Set in 1999, Night Plane blends psychological horror with flight attendant simulation gameplay, wrapped in a retro-inspired visual style, dark humor, and corporate cynicism.

Your job doesn't stop when things start getting strange. Follow protocol, keep your passengers happy, and pay attention to every detail — because not everyone aboard is who they claim to be.

The Night Plane Demo is available now for FREE on Steam.

🎮 Play the Demo: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5066370/Night_Plane_Demo/
🤝 Wishlist Night Plane: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3310570/Night_Plane/
💬 Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/RsSfDRpJZg
👀 Follow us on X: https://x.com/NightPlaneGame

Thank you for flying with Plane Airlines™.

#NightPlane #HorrorGame #IndieGames #IndieHorror #JobSimulator
